verdicts.decision_note: The client defines the AXP2101 as the normal system power source, its battery-input range, and the loads it must supply.
The message proposes an integrated-board architecture but does not specifically change the AXP2101 power-path scope; propagating it to this Requirement is not target-entailing.
The client explicitly requires simultaneous battery charging and system operation with 3.3V and 5V system rails.
The client adds battery efficiency and runtime as an implementation acceptance goal for the power-path design.
The client requires the AXP2101 power path to support USB-powered operation without an installed battery, citing the device specification.
First concrete failure on the USB power path: both boards run from battery but cannot sustain operation from 5V USB without rail collapse.
